tooSmall.title: This screen is too small for this mode
tooSmall.body: This mode needs more room on the screen. Close the second window or reduce the display size in your phone settings.
tooSmall.estimate: The screen may be too small

abaRoutine.handover: Pass the device to an adult
abaRoutine.transferHint: Almost mastered: it goes well with the pictures. One more time is needed, in another place or with another adult.

abaReinforcer.again: What shall we play for now?

abaReinforcement.repeated: You managed to do it again!

l1.title: One, two, three
l1.hook: I'm drawing the valley. How many leaves are here?
l1.atlas: The valley is on the map! One, two, three: you can see it at a glance.

model.s1: I look at all the leaves at once: three.
model.s2: I look for three dots. There they are!

t1.hint: Show the same number on your fingers.
t1.explain: Two stones, you can see it at a glance. Two!

t2.prompt: Match each pile to its dots.
t2.hint: Find the dots that match what you see.
t2.explain: One stone, two berries, three leaves.

t3.prompt: How many berries are on the branch?
t3.hint: Look at all the berries at once.
t3.explain: The berries are spread out, but there are still three.

t4.prompt: Which pile has one, two, three?
t4.hint: Stones or berries, it's how many that matters.
t4.explain: One and one, two and two, three and three.

l2.title: Counting to five
l2.atlas: The map is bigger now: we counted up to five!

model.s1: I count: one, two, three, four.
model.s2: The last number is four. So there are four!

t1.prompt: Count the stones. How many are there?
t1.hint: Slide your finger along the stones as you count.
t1.explain: One, two, three, four, five. Five!

t2.prompt: Tap the piles: three, four, five.
t2.hint: Count each pile one by one.

t3.hint: Look at all the berries at once.
t3.explain: Two berries, you can see it at a glance. Two!

t4.prompt: Count the piles and match them to the dots.
t4.hint: Count the pile and the dots.
t4.explain: Five berries, three stones, four leaves.

l3.title: Counting to ten
l3.hook: Oops, I lost count! Want to count one by one?
l3.atlas: Tali and I counted all the way to ten!

model.s1: One, two, three, four, five, six!
model.s2: The last number is six. So there are six!

t1.prompt: How many stones? Count them one by one.
t1.hint: Touch each stone once as you count.
t1.explain: The last number is seven. There are seven!

t2.prompt: Tap the piles: three, four, five.
t2.hint: Touch each one once. Don't skip any.
t2.explain: Each one once: three, four, five!

t3.prompt: How many leaves? Count them all.
t3.hint: Count the top first, then the bottom.
t3.explain: The last number is ten. There are ten!

t4.prompt: Count and match them to the dots.
t4.hint: Touch each one once as you count.
t4.explain: Five here, two here, and four here!

skills.subitize-1-3: Sees one, two, three at a glance
